column1: # Docs restructure: old URL prefix -> current URL prefix (including navigation flattening).
# Language-neutral paths; /nb/ and https://digitalpreservation.no variants are handled by the script.
# Longest prefix wins. Matching is case-insensitive and only on whole path segments.
# Slugs renamed in B1 (repair rows for re-runs).
# Old alias URLs point at the page itself (the policies/ variants repair an earlier run).
# Flattened navigation: Policies is top-level; Docs is the DPS tree.
